title: AICAD Diagnostic
description: Canonical shape of every diagnostic AICAD surfaces to a human or agent, frozen by RFC-0005 (docs/plan/17_CLI_DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA.md §11). Field/code stability policy is governed by project/OWNER_DECISIONS.md D10, RESOLVED by project/DECISION_LOG.md#DL-18 (AICAD-078): a committed code/field shape is durable; a compatibility-breaking change to this schema (removing a field, changing a field's meaning/type, removing a family) requires explicit owner review, recorded in DECISION_LOG.md, not a routine task commit. Note: this schema's own 'pattern' keyword on 'code' is documentation only; crates/cad-diagnostics's validator (crate::schema) does not evaluate 'pattern' — crates/cad-diagnostics's DiagnosticCode::parse is the authoritative check.
$comment: Schema version 1 (DL-18). Bump this comment's version number and record the change in project/DECISION_LOG.md on any future compatibility-breaking revision of this file.

title.description: A stable machine-referenceable title, e.g. AMBIGUOUS_REFERENCE.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Must never require an OCCT-specific concept to understand (RFC-0005 §5).

expected.description: Free-form expected-value payload; shape is diagnostic-code-specific.

observed.description: Free-form observed-value payload; shape is diagnostic-code-specific.

backend_details.description: Backend-specific (e.g. OCCT) debugging detail. Never the sole explanation of a diagnostic's message/title/suggestions (RFC-0005 §5).
